name: io.github.Pantheonn3D/cuecaps-mcp
title: Cuecaps
description: Animated word-by-word captions for your video and audio files, rendered on your machine by Cuecaps.

environmentVariables.name: CUECAPS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your key from cuecaps.com/account (Creator or Pro). list_styles and studio_link work without one.

environmentVariables.name: CUECAPS_CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Path to Chrome or Edge, when it isn't at a standard install path.
